prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce an ORIGINAL PRODUCTION ALBEDO TEXTURE ATLAS, not a concept sheet. References are approved DarkWinter stylized game materials: R2 dry cattail and K2 pale fleshy rhizome. Match their matte hand-painted softened-faceted game-art material language and exact muted palette. Need usable flat texture areas, NOT objects, NOT renders, NOT a photo, no lighting baked in, no cast shadow, no labels, no codes, no frames, no gutters, no divider lines. Fill the entire rectangular 3:2 canvas edge to edge with exactly THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of six equal rectangular tiles. Tile borders must align at 1/3 and 2/3 width, 1/2 height. Each tile is a continuous macro material painted face-on, detail subordinate to color and coherent fibers. NO random procedural static speckle.
TOP LEFT: dry cattail STRAP LEAF surface, longitudinal long straw-ochre / grey olive fibers running VERTICALLY, slender subdued ridges, softly weathered tan and muted warm highlights; no leaf silhouette.
TOP MIDDLE: cattail dense chocolate-brown SEED HEAD surface, short packed felt-like warm dark fibers, subtle medium brown mottling, artistic fine grain, not wood or fur strands.
TOP RIGHT: actual cattail RHIZOME OUTER SKIN, pale IVORY/buff cream with faint pinkish-tan scars and small damp-brown soil smudges, smooth-to-finely-fibrous soft flesh; NO bark or bamboo or wood grain; no giant node/cut outline.
BOTTOM LEFT: rhizome INNER FLESH, slightly lighter ivory dense soft pith with a few very subtle tiny spongy pores, low contrast, no growth rings, no chunky wood splinters, no food photo.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: soft chalk-white / cool off-white FROST/SNOW SURFACE, gently painted cloudy depth and a little irregular compressed powder, no crystals, no rocks, no isolated snow object, nearly neutral pale white.
BOTTOM RIGHT: very dark charcoal-brown DRIED CALYX/THORN material, soft dark woody fibre variation, useful for tiny rosehip dried sepals; not black void.
All tiles opaque. Painting should remain readable in an actual small stylized game mesh; no artificial shiny specularity, directional gradients, metal, or background margins.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL PRODUCTION ALBEDO TEXTURE ATLAS for approved DarkWinter woodland plants, not a concept sheet. Reference choices: M1 juniper, C2 cranberry, B2 lingonberry SHAPE BUT B3's BRONZE/ORANGE-BROWN leaf PALETTE, S2 wild rose. Keep the same hand-painted matte game-art, refined faceting and restrained northern colors. Flat materials seen head-on, no object render, no cast shadow, no labels, no text, no codes, no sample frames, no gutters, no seams drawn. Fill whole rectangular landscape canvas with exactly FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of eight equal rectangular material tiles. All borders at quarters of width, half height. Tiles must be fully opaque material areas to map to authored polygon geometry, not photographs or black-backed leaves. No random procedural static.
TOP LEFT: red-brown / muted warm-grey thin TWIG BARK, long fine directional fibres running vertically, patches of red-brown young bark, subdued flaky grey areas, restrained artistic depth.
TOP SECOND: muted grey-OLIVE JUNIPER NEEDLE SURFACE, slender lengthwise veins/fibres, restrained yellow-olive edges, no whole needle or branch silhouettes.
TOP THIRD: CRANBERRY LEAF surface, dark muted olive with burgundy-bronze winter mottling and a very fine understated vein rhythm, no bright green, no leaf silhouettes.
TOP FOURTH: LINGONBERRY B3 leaf material: warm aged copper, burnt sienna and muted olive-brown patches with a warm pale central-vein texture, dominant BRONZE like B3 and NOT the green B2 color. Leathery matte restrained surfaces, no jagged leaf silhouette.
BOTTOM LEFT: JUNIPER CONE SKIN, dark slate BLUE-BLACK with a dusty soft muted blue-grey wax bloom and slight natural variation. No blueberry star calyx shapes anywhere, no grape shine, no bright cyan.
BOTTOM SECOND: CRANBERRY FRUIT SKIN, deep restrained cranberry red / wine red mottles, matte waxy painted variation, not candy, no calyx or whole berry outline.
BOTTOM THIRD: LINGONBERRY FRUIT SKIN, rich muted brick-red to deep crimson, slight warm-red variation, not purple, no whole berries or stars.
BOTTOM FOURTH: ROSEHIP SKIN, muted orange-red through dark crimson painted patches, subtle lengthwise organic fibres, no whole fruit/calyx shape.
Keep consistent material scale, original painterly detail, neither pixelated vanilla Minecraft nor photoreal scan. Absolutely no baked light, glare, studio floor, black negative space or 3D sample balls.
